title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population, including the impacts of social influence, perceived risk, policy mandates, media, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals adjust mask adoption based on peers' adoption, perceived norms, and trust.

interactions.name: disease_transmission
interactions.description: Infectious contacts between people where mask use reduces transmission probability.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement actions influence compliance; fines or denial of service may occur.

interactions.name: information_flow
interactions.description: Media and interpersonal communication alter risk perception and adoption propensity.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers subject to inventory, price, and rationing.

interactions.name: supply_regulation
interactions.description: Government policies can affect retailer pricing and stock availability.

interactions.name: household_influence
interactions.description: Within-household norms and resource sharing affect adoption and availability.

interactions.name: location_attendance
interactions.description: People visit locations according to mobility patterns; locations host interactions and enforce mandates.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed mask adoption level during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches 50% of the population.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration
metrics.description: Total days during which adoption stays above a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: infection_attack_rate
metrics.description: Cumulative fraction of the population infected by the end of the simulation.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time accounting for mask use.

metrics.name: cases_averted
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections compared to a no-mask baseline.

metrics.name: compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rates within each location type.

metrics.name: equity_gap_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between demographic or socioeconomic subgroups.

metrics.name: inventory_outage_days
metrics.description: Number of days retailers experience zero inventory.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Total number of fines or enforcement interactions triggered.

metrics.name: misinformation_prevalence
metrics.description: Share of population exposed to and influenced by misinformation at each timestep.

metrics.name: cost_per_additional_adopter
metrics.description: Estimated public cost per additional mask adopter due to campaigns or subsidies.
